observation.command:
cd /workspace/01-frontend && for w in shared shell mfe-fp mfe-kp mfe-mp mfe-verwaltungsakt mfe-vp mfe-ws mfe1; do printf "%-20s dist=%s index=%s\n" "$w" "$([ -d $w/dist ] && echo yes || echo NO)" "$([ -f $w/dist/index.html ] && echo yes || echo NO)"; done
echo "=== serve shell dist via nginx to confirm app loads ==="
docker rm -f fetest >/dev/null 2>&1
docker run -d --name fetest -v /workspace/01-frontend/shell/dist:/usr/share/nginx/html:ro -p 18080:80 nginx:alpine >/dev/null 2>&1
sleep 4
curl -s -m 5 -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:18080/
curl -s -m 5 http://localhost:18080/ | head -c 200; echo
docker rm -f fetest >/dev/null 2>&1
